feeds.title: The Devil Drinks Vodka
feeds.description: The author is going to write about her recovery in this blog. A mom, wife, and professional's journey on recovering from addiction.

feeds.title: LIFE WITHOUT VODKA ROCKS | Quitting alcohol on my own terms
feeds.description: I'm a 50-something wife, mother, grandmother, daughter, sister -navigating the world without alcohol for the first time in my adult life. I'm going to try this for the next 37 years. Then maybe I'll revisit the issue.

feeds.title: Modern Mommy Madness
feeds.description: My name is Harmony. I am a freelance writer, wife, and mom of three. I made a name for myself writing humour content revolving around alcohol and motherhood. Then, in 2017, I got sober. I'm excited to share my story and chipping away at the stigma that surrounds alcoholism, addiction, and the silent struggles that plague so many modern women - particularly mothers.

feeds.title: doctorgettingsober
feeds.description: A psychiatrist blogging about her own demons and trying to deal with them sober

feeds.title: Ditching the Wine | Getting myself sober; the ups and downs
feeds.description: My name is Claire. I gave up alcohol on the 17th of November 2019 following a challenging two years struggling with anxiety and depression. I am a 47-year-old mum of 2 boys, a full-time worker for the NHS and I am addicted to wine. This blog is part of my journey to find Claire.

feeds.title: Laura McKowen Blog
feeds.description: Laura writes about addiction, sobriety, motherhood, marriage, divorce, anxiety, mental health, personal development, and spirituality on this blog.

feeds.title: Sober Julie » Sober doesn't Suck!
feeds.description: Julie Elsdon-Height is a Mum to 2 wonderful little ladies, wife to an amazing man, blogger, speaker, Christ-follower who faced her Alcoholism and got fed up and decided to learn how to experience this journey of life fully.

feeds.title: Sober Moms Guide Blog
feeds.description: On the Sober Moms Guide to Recovery, join Rosemary O'Connor as she offers you the help, hope, and happiness you deserve through an amazing life of recovery.

feeds.title: Mummy was a Secret Drinker
feeds.description: A blog about how to stop drinking alcohol and stay sober. The author Clare Pooley is a middle-aged, over-educated, over-privileged, mum of three who had a long love affair with high priced, good quality wine until she realized that the relationship was going nowhere but downhill, so she showed it the door and started blogging to take her mind off her broken heart.

feeds.title: 800 Recovery Hub Blog | Written by people in recovery for people in recovery
feeds.description: I am Victoria B., I am 21 years sober, 10 years married, and 8 years a mom. I live in a small town in Texas. This blog is to help the drug or alcohol addicts to recover from their addiction.

feeds.title: Ainsobriety
feeds.description: I'm a 42-year-old mom of 2 who has finally taken action to make my life better. I put down the wine glass on December 1, 2013. I have a nice therapist, a supportive family, and have found yoga as the path for me.

feeds.title: Finding a Sober Miracle | A woman's quest for one year of sobriety
feeds.description: This blog is by and about Shawna Carpenter, and her journey to recovery.

feeds.title: thebeerportal
feeds.description: I'm actually a pretty nice lady and a mother. I've never really hidden my drinking- my friends and family know that I am a heavy drinker. What they don't know is how much drinking changes me, and how much it hurts me. In this blog, you will get to know about my journey to recovery.

feeds.title: suburban betty | clean & serene
feeds.description: My name is Christina and I live in Oregon. I'm married to a banjo player and I have two teenagers and two tuxedo cats. on June 1, 2015, I decided to put down the wine and see if I could still get through life. It's going pretty well.

feeds.title: The Sober Modern Mom | Navigating through sobriety, motherhood, marriage, and life.
feeds.description: First off, yes, I AM an alcoholic, sober since May 21, 2016. I am married and am a mother of two daughters. Years ago, I got lost in the fog of addiction and depression. Finding sobriety, this enlightening way of life, has made me happier than I ever thought I could be. I am so excited to share my journey with you.

feeds.title: #SOBERSASS
feeds.description: Hello all, I am Kelly Anderson, sober mom and transformational life coach. I'm living my best life, are you? Get past the fears and shame and limiting beliefs to live the life of your dreams. Take one step today in the direction of the woman you want to be. Need help getting there...I've been there and taken the steps. Let me guide you to your best life.

feeds.title: Heya, Monster. | A SoberBlog by a TallWoman.
feeds.description: 'Heya, Monster,' said the girl with the drinking problem. Been working on recognizing this bit of beast inside and part of me for the last decade, on and off. Time to do something about it. I've been reading sober blogs by other women, and think it's time I start my own.

feeds.title: Hurrah for coffee! | My new sober adventure!
feeds.description: Hurrah for Coffee is a 38-year-old mother of two who used to be severely addicted to alcohol. She has seen what lies at the bottom of a bottle of Gin and it ain't rainbow unicorns! This is her personal blog on her journey to a sober life.

feeds.title: Bye-Bye Beer
feeds.description: I started this blog in September 2011, a couple of months after I'd stopped drinking. I was going to meetings then and just struggling to get a handle on the feelings and fears I had about staying sober. This is a blog about sobriety and the good stuff that comes along with it.

feeds.title: Mrs D Is Going Without
feeds.description: I am a 47-year-old wife, mother, author, blogger & recovery advocate. Sober since September 2011. I used to be a boozy housewife. Now I'm not. This is my blog.

feeds.title: The Sober Girl, Wife and Mum
feeds.description: My name is Daisy H. I was drinking a bottle of wine a night, sometimes more, for the past 20 years, around 65+ units a week. I've forgotten how many times I've tried to stop, I'm a mid-forties professional woman with a family. I started an online journal/blog to try and help myself and others too.

feeds.title: runningfromwine | Welcome to my journey to end my addiction to wine!
feeds.description: I'm 41 and have two wonderful sons, a husband, three Beagles, and a cat. I am a highly functional alcoholic who is quite the snob when it comes to wine. Problem is, I have 1-2 bottles a night and don't remember most nights anymore. This blog is my journey to recovery.

feeds.title: SOBRIETEASE | God, Grant Me the Serenity to Laugh at Life
feeds.description: The blog is intended to be a humorous but heartfelt journey about a suburban mom through recovery and sobriety into a better life.
